integrity: All probability formulas and the unique-maximizer claim have analytic proofs; finite numerical tests are corroboration only. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed distinct base vertices, the third point centered on their hyperbolic midpoint, curvature -1, arclength-uniform circle or area-uniform disk. No distribution for randomized bases or conditional circumradius. The classical two-horocycle admissibility locus is credited as prior work.
title: Exact hyperbolic circumcircle sampling law and a sharp half-exponential tail
